context_and_flow.screen_type: Account registration flow for a banking application.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: User onboarding: gathering initial identity information to initiate the account creation process.
ux_patterns: The stepper uses simple icon markers (user profile, shield, heart) to denote the flow stages.
Green is the primary brand color, used for the logo and the 'Next' call-to-action button, ensuring high prominence.
Input fields follow a standard mobile design pattern with clear labels.
The overall design system prioritizes accessibility through high contrast text and generous whitespace.
